description: Fill (Paint Bucket tool) or erase (Magic Eraser tool) the area of similar colour around a point on the active layer, within the selection if there is one. Erasing on the Background layer turns it into an ordinary layer, as the Magic Eraser does

color.description: "#RRGGBB", "rgb(r,g,b)" (0-255), "cmyk(c,m,y,k)" (0-100), "gray(g)" (0-100, 100 = black), "hsb(h,s,b)" (0-360, 0-100, 0-100) or "lab(L,a,b)". Fill only. Default the foreground colour

sampleAllLayers.description: Judge colours from all visible layers. Default false

tolerance.description: How different a colour may be and still be included. Default 32

name: fill_at_point
title: Fill At Point
